title: elymus × brachyphyllus
intro: Elymus × brachyphyllus, commonly known as Rescue Grass, is a hybrid plant species in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Rescue Grass include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Elymus × brachyphyllus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
